items.ex: Not only means not just this one thing. There is something more, and often it is even bigger. We say not only this, but also that.
exs: She's not only my lash artist, she's also my friend.
This glue not only dries fast, it also lasts longer.

src.t: And the journey is not only the reward, the journey is the only thing there is.
src.zh: 而且过程不只是回报本身，过程就是唯一存在的东西。

items.ex: A reward is something good you get because you did something well or worked hard. It is like a prize at the end.
exs: A happy client is the best reward.
After a long week, I give myself a small reward.

src.t: And the journey is not only the reward, the journey is the only thing there is.
src.zh: 而且过程不只是回报本身，过程就是唯一存在的东西。

items.ex: Human nature is the way all people naturally think and act. It is not learned. Everybody is born with it.
exs: It's human nature to want to be liked.
Getting bored is just human nature.

src.t: Even success, it’s human nature to bank it very quickly, right,
src.ft: Even success, it’s human nature to bank it very quickly, right, because the normal loop that we run through is you sit around, you’re bored, then you want something, then when you want something you decide you’re not gonna be happy until you get that thing, then you start your bout of suffering or anticipation while you strive to get that thing.
src.zh: 就连成功，人的天性也是很快就把它“存进账里”、习以为常，对吧，因为我们通常走的循环是：你闲坐着，觉得无聊，然后你想要某样东西，接着一旦想要了，你就认定得到它之前你不会开心，然后你就开始了一段受苦或期待的日子，同时拼命去争取那样东西。

items.zh: 把它存起来；当成理所当然

items.ex: To get used to something means it slowly starts to feel normal. At first it is new, then it is not special anymore.
exs: I got used to waking up early.
You'll get used to the new tweezers.

src.t: If you get that thing then you get used to it, and then you get bored again,
src.ft: If you get that thing then you get used to it, and then you get bored again, then a few months later you want something else, and if you don’t get it then you’re unhappy for a bit, and then you get over it then you want something else.
src.zh: 如果你得到了，你就会习惯它，然后又开始无聊，然后过几个月你又想要别的东西，如果没得到，你会难过一阵子，然后走出来，接着又想要别的。

items.ex: A cycle is a set of things that happen again and again in the same order. When it ends, it starts again.
exs: Lashes grow in a natural cycle.

src.t: That’s the normal cycle. So whether you’re happy or unhappy at the end, it tends not to last.

items.ex: Entirely means completely, one hundred percent. Not entirely true means partly true.

src.t: Again, don’t know if that’s entirely true. I think money can buy you happiness if you earned it,

src.zh: 再说一次，我不知道那是不是完全正确。我觉得如果钱是你自己挣来的，它是能买到快乐的，因为这一路上你会对自己既有自豪感又有自信，而且你会有一种成就感，你下定决心去做一件事，结果你做对了，所以我敢说那种感觉会一直留着，再加上我说过的，它能解决你的钱的问题。

items.ex: In general means usually, or when you look at the whole picture, not small details.
exs: In general, clients like natural styles.
In general, I'm a happy person.

src.t: So I don’t want to be too glib about it, but I would say in general, this loop that we run through of desire, dopamine, fulfillment, unfulfillment—you have to enjoy the journey.
src.zh: 所以我不想把这事说得太轻巧，但我会说，总的来说，我们反复经历的这个循环——欲望、多巴胺、满足、不满足——你得享受过程。

items.ex: Dopamine is a chemical in your brain. It gives you a feeling of wanting and reward, like when you get a like on social media.
exs: Checking your phone gives you a little hit of dopamine.

items.ex: Ninety-nine percent means 99 out of 100. People use it to mean almost all.
exs: Ninety-nine percent of my clients come back.

src.t: The journey is all there is. Ninety-nine percent of your time is spent on the journey, so what kind of a journey is it if you’re not going to enjoy it?
src.zh: 过程就是一切。你百分之九十九的时间都花在过程上，所以如果你不打算享受它，那这算什么样的过程呢？
